summary: L1 — `runs-watch` prints a false default-interval warning on every poll in a project-alone setup , `:556-558`. With a complete `settings.toml` and no global config, the ENOENT branch warns "poll interval is the default, 120s" on every iteration, but the project's `postmaster.poll_seconds` actually wins (e.g. 30s). Fix: resolve the project value first; only warn from the global fallback when the project supplies none.
body: **L2 — `launch.ts` error messages blame the global config for values from the project file** — `scripts/launch.ts:148`, `:175`, `:186-201`, `:209-223`, `:1361-1362`. With `--project`, `die(...)` still interpolates `sourcePath` (`~/.postmaster/config.toml`) even when the bad value came from the project's `settings.toml`, sending the user to edit the wrong file. front-door and plane fixed this; launch was left behind. Fix: label with `resolved.projectFile ?? sourcePath`.

body: **L3 — documented "projects_roots always comes from the global config" invariant not enforced** — `AGENTS.md:246-248`, `settings.example.toml:5` vs `effective-config.ts:971-981` (`stripLegacy`). A local `projects_roots` lands in the effective config while docs say it's global-only. No consumer reads it today, so no user-visible break. Fix: `delete out.projects_roots` in `stripLegacy`, or reword the docs.

body: **L4 — acceptance unrecordable for an explicit `--config` path** — `effective-config.ts:79-80`, `:870`, `:801` vs `project-settings.ts:111`. Readers given a non-global config path gate against `dirname(<path>)/accepted-project-settings.json`, but `accept` only writes beside `globalConfigPath()` — so a tracked settings file stays permanently `pending` and unfixable by the user. Fix: accept an optional config path, or resolve acceptance against the global store.
